description: Dependency updates through the Mend Renovate GitHub App: the actions of .github/workflows/ and the images pinned in the Makefile.

Every update is a pull request someone reads and merges by hand: no automerge. The labs are built once and not maintained, so the copies of files of other repositories under drills/ are left alone. A release is proposed only once it is 3 days old, because a hijacked release is usually pulled within hours (trivy, March 2026); vulnerability alerts skip that wait and the schedule.
Commit messages follow the repository's conventional commits (chore(deps), fix(deps) for a vulnerability fix); their text is generated by the bot, in English.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Opened at once, outside the schedule and without minimumReleaseAge. Needs the repository's Dependency graph and Dependabot alerts.

customManagers.description: Images pinned as <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> with a '# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>' line right above (MARKDOWNLINT_IMAGE, LYCHEE_IMAGE of the Makefile).

packageRules.description: chore(deps) for every update; vulnerabilityAlerts above turns a vulnerability fix into fix(deps).
GitHub Actions, pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment: one pull request for non-major updates.
The images of the check (Makefile): one pull request for non-major updates. Both are also pinned in the Makefile of the code repository: keep them in step.
